name: dev-pipeline
description: Autonomous pipeline from an intaken ticket to a reviewed PR — build and review in separate sessions, gated by five artifact milestones — a thin scheduler (/dev-pipeline:run) over payload blocks that stay individually invokable (/dev-pipeline:build, /dev-pipeline:review). Tracker adapters (github|jira), a Workflow-based review fan-out, retro; opt-in cost block and merge-boundary evidence. Reads per-repo static context from .claude/second-shift.config.json.
